title: Dapper
description: A lightweight micro-ORM that extends the IDbConnection interface for high-performance data access.

data.text: Dapper is a simple object mapper for .NET that extends the `IDbConnection` interface. It focuses on performance and simplicity, providing fast, type-safe access to database results without the overhead of a full ORM.

data.title: Querying with Dapper
data.content: Execute a query and map results to objects.

terms.definition: A lightweight ORM that provides object mapping without change tracking or migrations.
An interface for database connections that Dapper extends.

data.title: Note
data.text: Dapper does not track changes. You are responsible for writing INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE statements.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Use Dapper when you need raw SQL performance with object mapping convenience.

data.title: Exercise
data.description: Query a database using Dapper and map results to a strongly-typed list.
data.expectedOutcome: A list of User objects populated from the database query.
